title: moi drive (drives/<friendly-name>.yaml)
description: One storage filesystem in the moi drives catalog. The file is named by a friendly name (the drive's label if set); the required `uuid` field is the authoritative reconciliation key. A scanner (e.g. fili) populates these; a human annotates label/privacy/notes. Unknown keys and x-<tool> namespaces are permitted and must be preserved.

uuid.description: Filesystem UUID; reconciles the same disk across machines.

fs.description: Filesystem type, e.g. btrfs, ext4, exfat.

device.description: Machine the drive is attached to.

privacy.description: Sensitivity of the drive's contents; parallels moi privacy stages (SPEC 3.7).

folders.description: Top-level folders on the drive, keyed by name. Each value is null (just catalogued) or an object of per-folder metadata.

backup_of.description: What this folder backs up — a drive label, path, device, or project. Its presence marks the folder as a backup.
